title: ASTROGOLF
summary: A space-themed golf game driven by a custom Python N-body simulation engine.

cover.alt: Game screen with an astronaut, two glowing orange and blue gravity wells and a power meter in space

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Built a space-themed golf game driven by a custom Python-based N-body simulation engine. Players launch an astronaut through gravitationally complex galactic courses, using orbital mechanics to slingshot around massive bodies.

Developed with object-oriented design, the engine numerically solves Newtonian dynamics for realistic motion. Features include 10 handcrafted levels, endless multiplayer survival mode, and animated visualizations of gravitational interactions.
